answer: Each identity enters a 16-epoch delivery corridor. After commitment, a horizon beacon assigns four unrelated requesters; the kth account in one funding harbor must serve 4k requesters, so 100 aliases owe 20,200 verified deliveries. A meadow Merkle root binds assignments, receipts, and outputs. Validators replay 10% of jobs; a reused requester or copied result burns a 40-POA bond and restarts every linked corridor.
